metadata.description: The Ray Framework marketplace: an evidence-first security review pipeline distributed as one installable plugin.

plugins.name: ray
plugins.description: The full Ray Framework: 33 skills and 5 subagents spanning codebase mapping, threat modeling, the domain audit suite (web + memory-safety + AI/LLM + dependencies/SBOM + infrastructure-as-code), adversarial validation, sandboxed reproduction, risk scoring and reporting, a live red-team/blue-team loop, external attack-surface recon, a tiered-autonomy detection-and-response analyst, operational maintenance auditing, a write-time secret-leak guard, a real-browser product-coherence & QA verifier, a legal-engineering & compliance layer, and a high-precision general code-review skill — with real bundled tools exposed over MCP.
